SEO_TITLE: NFTs Use Token Standards Like ERC-721
FACT_EXPLANATION: NFTs rely on token standards to define functionality. Ethereum’s ERC-721 standard specifies that each token is non-fungible, indivisible, and uniquely identifiable. This allows marketplaces, wallets, and platforms to understand and interact with NFTs reliably. Counterintuitively, the same code can support millions of unique tokens, each with a different owner, metadata, and rarity. ERC-1155 further evolved the standard, allowing semi-fungible or batch-minted tokens. Historically, inconsistent digital assets couldn’t interoperate; these standards unify the ecosystem. They ensure developers can innovate while collectors maintain trust. The inner logic of NFTs is grounded in protocols that encode ownership, transfers, and compatibility. Without token standards, NFTs would be a chaotic, isolated landscape. Standards turn digital uniqueness into a reproducible, interoperable framework.
